review.algorithm_assessment: Create states for vertex plus player-to-move. First compute Georgiy-forced wins: his states are existential, Gennady states universal. Outside this attractor Georgiy cannot win; he then prefers terminating in a loss to a draw, while Gennady prefers a draw to a win. The same existential/universal attractor to Georgiy-terminal states yields forced finite Gennady wins in this subgame; all remaining states are draws. Terminal seeds and edges respect player alternation.
